visual.description: Top utility bar split into three zones: left cluster (UNITED STATES, CONTACT US, SERVICES), center logo (Cartier script), right cluster (heart, account, store locator, cart icons).
Single horizontal row of 7 navigation items evenly spaced across full width, with a vertical divider before a search icon on the far right.
A white modal dialog centered horizontally and vertically over a full-bleed background image, roughly 60% viewport width, containing a title, body text, and a 3-button row at the bottom.
Three equal-width CTA buttons arranged in a single horizontal row at the base of the modal: AGREE (filled black), CONFIGURE ALL COOKIES (outlined), ALLOW TECHNICAL COOKIES ONLY (filled black).
A single full-viewport-width editorial photograph of a woman wearing jewelry, visible behind and around the modal overlay, with no text overlaid directly on the image outside the modal.
